nodes.name: On any workflow error
nodes.notes: 01 and 02 name this workflow as their Error Workflow. It catches whatever their own error outputs did not.

parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(key, value), '{}'::jsonb) AS config
FROM config;

INSERT INTO dead_letters
  (workflow_id, workflow_name, execution_id, execution_url, node, kind,
   payload, attempts, error, reason)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'crashed', $6::jsonb, 1, $7, 'crashed')
-- n8n re-reports an interrupted execution on every restart. The repeat
-- inserts nothing, returns no row, and so sends no second alert.
ON CONFLICT (workflow_id, execution_id)
  WHERE reason = 'crashed' AND execution_id <> 'none'
  DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Dead letter
nodes.notes: Recorded before alerting, so a broken alert channel never loses the failure.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: `${$('Read the error').first().json.workflow_name} CRASHED at '${$('Read the error').first().json.node}'\n${$('Read the error').first().json.error}\n${$('Read the error').first().json.execution_url}` }) }}

nodes.name: Alert
nodes.notes: Must not fail: an error workflow that throws has nothing to catch it.
